lines.lyric_hangul: I am not me
lines.lyric_translation: I am not me

lines.lyric: Dodaeche eonjebuteo shijagilkka pulliji anneun munje
lines.lyric_hangul: 도대체 언제부터 시작일까 풀리지 않는 문제
lines.lyric_translation: When did it start? This problem that can’t be solved

lines.lyric: Naega nuguinga geu nugudo naen jeok eopneun sukje
lines.lyric_hangul: 내가 누구인가 그 누구도 낸 적 없는 숙제
lines.lyric_translation: Who am I? It’s homework that no one ever assigned me

lines.lyric: Naege seongribdwel manan gongshikdeureul weugi jeone
lines.lyric_hangul: 내게 성립될 만한 공식들을 외우기 전에
lines.lyric_translation: Before I could memorize the formulas that materialized before me

lines.lyric: Mwol daeibhalji seontaekhalmanhan gihwejocha geoye eopseotne
lines.lyric_hangul: 뭘 대입할지 선택할만한 기회조차 거의 없었네
lines.lyric_translation: I had no chance to decide on what answer to give

lines.lyric: Eodil ganeunjido moreun chae ildaneun dalligiman hae
lines.lyric_hangul: 어딜 가는지도 모른 채 일단은 달리기만 해
lines.lyric_translation: Without even knowing where I’m going, I’m just running

lines.lyric_hangul: 옆에 거울들 눈치를 보며 그냥 따라다니기만 해
lines.lyric_translation: Cautious of the mirrors next to me / I’m just following

lines.lyric_hangul: 아직 어려서 그렇단 이유 크면 더 헤맬 거 같은 느낌은
lines.lyric_translation: If I say it’s because I’m still young / I think I’ll get even more lost once I grow up

lines.lyric: Hollanseureon jeongshin soge gyeopchyeo dallida gyesok giutgiut
lines.lyric_hangul: 혼란스런 정신 속에 겹쳐 달리다 계속 기웃기웃
lines.lyric_translation: My confusion overlapping as I run, I keep pondering

lines.lyric: Hollan soge gachyeo nado ajik nal jal mollaseo
lines.lyric_hangul: 혼란 속에 갇혀 나도 아직 날 잘 몰라서
lines.lyric_translation: Trapped in confusion, I still don’t know myself

lines.lyric: Neoneun ani dabi eopneun naege tto mureo
lines.lyric_hangul: 너는 아니 답이 없는 내게 또 물어
lines.lyric_translation: Do you know? Asking me, who doesn’t have any answers

lines.lyric: You make me cry nae soneul jabajwo
lines.lyric_hangul: You make me cry 내 손을 잡아줘
lines.lyric_translation: You make me cry, hold my hand

lines.lyric: Ne apeseo nal barabonda
lines.lyric_hangul: 네 앞에서 날 바라본다
lines.lyric_translation: I’m in front of you, you’re looking at me

lines.lyric: Geoul soge bichin nan miro eh
lines.lyric_hangul: 거울 속에 비친 난 미로 eh
lines.lyric_translation: Reflected in the mirror, I’m a maze

lines.lyric: Nae aneul bichwojul my mirror no
lines.lyric_hangul: 내 안을 비춰줄 my mirror no
lines.lyric_translation: My insides are reflected in my mirror, no

lines.lyric_hangul: 어디서 찾아야 할까 for once I wish I could see myself
lines.lyric_translation: Where can I find it? / For once I wish I could see myself

parts.lyric: For once I wish I could see myself

lines.lyric: Nan gyesokhaeseo chaja hemaego isseo oh
lines.lyric_hangul: 난 계속해서 찾아 헤매고 있어 uh
lines.lyric_translation: I keep looking for it

lines.lyric: I’m not me neo dodaeche nuguya
lines.lyric_hangul: I'm not me 너 도대체 누구야
lines.lyric_translation: I’m not me, who are you?

lines.lyric: Naega aldeon nae moseubgwaneun neomudo dareun na
lines.lyric_hangul: 내가 알던 내 모습과는 너무도 다른 나
lines.lyric_translation: I’m so different from the me I used to know

lines.lyric: Moreuneun ge mana kkumeul duljjae chigo
lines.lyric_hangul: 모르는 게 많아 꿈을 둘째 치고
lines.lyric_translation: So many things I don’t know, my dreams are only second

lines.lyric: Nae sok mamjocha mollaseo nunmulman deo maechigo
lines.lyric_hangul: 내 속 맘조차 몰라서 눈물만 더 맺히고
lines.lyric_translation: I don’t even know how I feel so only tears well up

lines.lyric_hangul: 물음표들과 점 셋으로 끝나는 매일 반복되는 상황
lines.lyric_translation: Every day, the situation ends / With either a question mark or three dots

lines.lyric: Naega anin geot gatdagado mattaneun sogmameun banghwang
lines.lyric_hangul: 내가 아닌 것 같다가도 맞다는 속맘은 방황
lines.lyric_translation: I don’t feel like myself but then I do

lines.lyric_hangul: 하기만 해 잔인하게 해답은 답을 숨기고 난 또 찾기만 해
lines.lyric_translation: My heart is lost and the answer is hiding itself / I’m only looking for it

parts.lyric: Dabeul sumgigo nan tto chatgiman hae

lines.lyric: Sondael su eopshi keojin naye uimun dabi eopne
lines.lyric_hangul: 손댈 수 없이 커진 나의 의문 답이 없네
lines.lyric_translation: I can’t touch it, my question is growing, but there’s no answer

lines.lyric: Hollan soge gachyeo nado ajik nal jal mollaseo
lines.lyric_hangul: 혼란 속에 갇혀 나도 아직 날 잘 몰라서

lines.lyric: Nae aneul bichwojul my mirror no
lines.lyric_hangul: 내 안을 비춰줄 my mirror no
lines.lyric_translation: My insides are reflected in my mirror, no

lines.lyric_translation: Where can I find it? / For once I wish I could see myself

lines.lyric: Nan gyesokhaeseo chaja hemaego isseo oh
lines.lyric_hangul: 난 계속해서 찾아 헤매고 있어 uh
lines.lyric_translation: I keep looking for it

lines.lyric: Naega nugunji nado moreuji
lines.lyric_hangul: 내가 누군지 나도 모르지
lines.lyric_translation: ⁯I don’t even know who I am

lines.lyric: Shikin daero yeogikkaji watteon memories
lines.lyric_hangul: 시킨 대로 여기까지 왔던 memories
lines.lyric_translation: I just did as I was told in the memories

lines.lyric: Eodiga naega garaneun gil georeoga
lines.lyric_hangul: 어디가 내가 가라는 길 걸어가
lines.lyric_translation: What is the path I must go on?

lines.lyric: Mudji ma ildan ttwineun ge useoniya
lines.lyric_hangul: 묻지 마 일단 뛰는 게 우선이야
lines.lyric_translation: Don’t ask, just run first

lines.lyric: Naega nugunji nado moreuji

lines.lyric: Who am I naega nareul boneunde gami an wa
lines.lyric_hangul: Who am I 내가 나를 보는데 감이 안 와
lines.lyric_translation: Who am I? I’m looking at myself but I can’t figure it out

lines.lyric: I am not hokshi molla dareun geoureul chaja
lines.lyric_hangul: I am not 혹시 몰라 다른 거울을 찾아
lines.lyric_translation: I am not, maybe I need to find a different mirror

lines.lyric_hangul: 얼마나 헤매야 내가 나를 보며 웃을 수 있을까
lines.lyric_translation: How much more do I have to wander / Until I can look at myself and smile?
